content:
“The best bits of a Megasloth are cut out to make this health-imbibing steak dinner.”— *Fallout 76 Vault Dweller's Survival Guide* p.105

**Megasloth Tenderloin** is a consumable item in *Fallout 76*.

A tenderloin from a Mega Sloth that has been cooked over a fire and served with a side of beans.

| Materials: | | Requirements: | | Produces: | 
| Boiled Water (2) Megasloth Meat (2) Salt (2) Silt Bean (2) Wood (1) | | **Build at:****Learn Method:**Learned from plan/recipe Recipe: Megasloth Tenderloin | | Megasloth Tenderloin (1) | 

- Can be crafted at any Cooking Station with the correct ingredients, after having learned the Recipe.
- May be sold by Yasmin Chowdhury.
